name: caption-slice
title: Caption Slice
description: Each word arrives cut in two, the top half sliding in from the left and the bottom from the right, locking together the moment it is spoken.
useWhen: Tech, product or launch video where the captions should feel engineered: every word assembles itself on cue instead of fading in.
You want word-by-word arrival with a sharp, horizontal energy that stays out of the subject's way vertically.
avoidWhen: The arrival should be soft and quiet: use caption-blur-in.
Words should land with playful overshoot: use caption-bounce-in.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Captions
variables.description: Word timings as JSON: [{"text","startMs","endMs"}] in milliseconds, or [{"text","start","end"}] in seconds. A transcript from Mosio works as is.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Caption text size in pixels (at 1080 px on the short side).

variables.label: Page window
variables.description: Words that start within this window share one page of captions. A sentence end always starts a new page.

variables.label: Hold
variables.description: How long the last page stays after its final word.

variables.label: Shadow
variables.description: Soft shadow behind the text for legibility on footage.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: How far each half starts from its place, in em.
